# `split`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Splits `str` around occurrences that match `regex` and returns an array with a length of at most `limit`

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
split(str, regex, limit)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- split, example 1
> SELECT split('oneAtwoBthreeC', '[ABC]');
["one","two","three",""]
```

```sql
-- split, example 2
> SELECT split('oneAtwoBthreeC', '[ABC]', -1);
["one","two","three",""]
```

```sql
-- split, example 3
> SELECT split('oneAtwoBthreeC', '[ABC]', 2);
["one","twoBthreeC"]
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
